mapper.select: SELECT user_no, neighbor, like_post, like_comment, like_reply, comment_on_post, reply_on_comment, mention, tag_post, tag_story, story_react FROM ultary_notification_setting WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_notification_setting ( user_no, neighbor, like_post, like_comment, like_reply, comment_on_post, reply_on_comment, mention, tag_post, tag_story, story_react ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{neighbor}, #{likePost}, #{likeComment}, #{likeReply}, #{commentOnPost}, #{replyOnComment}, #{mention}, #{tagPost}, #{tagStory}, #{storyReact} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE neighbor = VALUES(neighbor), like_post = VALUES(like_post), like_comment = VALUES(like_comment), like_reply = VALUES(like_reply), comment_on_post = VALUES(comment_on_post), reply_on_comment = VALUES(reply_on_comment), mention = VALUES(mention), tag_post = VALUES(tag_post), tag_story = VALUES(tag_story), story_react = VALUES(story_react)
